jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. jobs.description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot)
jobs.description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin . At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us to let our consumers maximize value for their money by providing a world-class shopping rewards experience online and in-store, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc. Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap. Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency. Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.   Your Profile: We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation. 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side. Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot . Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems. Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular. Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure). Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts. Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns. Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills. Passion for delivering clean code

You will be embedded in the Cloud Engineering team, report into the Security Officer, and work closely together to identify risks, set priorities, and drive security issues through remediation. What you will own Run our public bug bounty program : triage reports, reproduce and validate findings, communicate clearly with security researchers, and drive remediation through to closure. Implement, configure, and maintain security tooling across our development and cloud environments. Support security incident response, including investigation, containment, remediation, and follow-up. Maintain clear, complete, and auditable records of vulnerability and incident work in our tracking systems. Build security automation and guardrails that scale across the development lifecycle: CI/CD security checks, policy-as-code, GitHub automation, and automated cloud security controls, so secure defaults are enforced by tooling rather than review. Participate in threat modeling and architecture reviews for new services and major changes. We are also building out our ISMS, which creates opportunities to contribute to security-tooling evaluations, technical vendor assessments, and proof-of-concept work. Formal compliance ownership, vendor risk assessments, and customer security questionnaires remain with the Security Officer. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. The Data & Science Org At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo. Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers. Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee. As an Economist at Deliveroo you will help scale our business and improve the experience for restaurants, riders, and eaters. Using experimental or observational data, you will get to help answer questions like: Which markets/cities should we enter next? How can we incentivise good rider behaviour? What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants? Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players? What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them? What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants? jobs.title: Labour AI Specialist
jobs.description: About Sona Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. jobs.description: <p>RDQ327R180</p> <p><strong>Staff Security Engineer, Incident Response</strong></p> <p>The Incident Response team's mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardised manner. We're a tight-knit team of security incident responders and incident handlers doing "Security for Databricks on Databricks", using our own platform to create near-real-time log analytics, alerting and forensics.</p> <p>You will be an individual contributor on the security Incident Response (IR) team at Databricks, reporting to the regional IR manager. You will be responsible for conducting security analysis and forensics, responding to high-priority alerts and contributing to automations and agentic capabilities. You will be a security multiplier and help the team scale security incident response at Databricks.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will respond to incidents as part of a distributed 24x7 operations and on-call schedule.</li> <li>You will triage and respond to security events and alerts, ensuring quick and effective containment.</li> <li>You will conduct analysis and forensics across a range of data sources to determine the timeline and impact of security events.</li> <li>You will provide technical leadership and influence team direction.</li> <li>You will develop solutions, including leveraging AI and agentic platforms, to deliver autonomous capabilities, expedite your work and scale the impact of the team.</li> <li>You will communicate technical decisions through design docs and tech talks, and mentor junior security responders via security guidance, design reviews and code reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree AND 7+ years experience in Incident Response work OR Master's Degree AND 5+ years experience.</li> <li>Cloud security expertise in at least 1 of AWS, GCP or Azure, and proficiency in the others.</li> <li>Proficiency in AI/LLM and agentic capabilities. Prefer experience with building and operating agentic systems in a security setting.</li> <li>Broad security subject matter expertise.</li> <li>Expertise in a few core IR skills (DFIR , Reverse Engineering, Traditional Network Security, Storage and access security, Sandboxing, Compute security, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise Security and SaaS applications.</li> <li>Working knowledge of a SIEM and SOAR.</li> <li>Experience building Incident Response Tooling, scripting language skills and experience with AI coding tools.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. members.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Retail Media analytics, including building and troubleshooting Looker Explores, resolving data-quality issues, and scoping aggregation tables to optimize performance.</li> <li>Help establish the Ecom Analytics Engineering remit by translating business definitions of core metrics into clear technical logic.</li> <li>Own and maintain the metric dictionary for core Ecom metrics, defining valid dimensions for splitting and aggregating data.</li> <li>Act as the analytics liaison to Analytics Engineering for building reporting marts and prioritizing metric migrations.</li> <li>Automate recurring Retail Media and partner performance reporting to eliminate manual effort and boost data reliability.</li> <li>Conduct Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles.  📊  Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. ✨  Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.   Cette thèse de doctorat sera rattachée au département Génie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Société (EVS). Pour répondre aux enjeux des transitions écologique, énergétique et industrielle, le département GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et privés) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de résilience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi à apporter des solutions nouvelles en matière d'analyse, de modélisation et d'évaluation environnementale des systèmes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables. 🏠 Contexte Présentation du sujet Le changement climatique met en lumière, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vulnérabilités et liens de dépendance généralisée de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les chaînes de valeur, et modes d'organisation économique et technique, éléments souvent déconnectés de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du bâtiment, Cimerman (2023) évoque une tendance depuis plusieurs décennies de « simplification cartésienne » de la conception et de l'opération du bâti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le développement d'un imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », se traduisant par une superposition d'éléments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'être pilotés au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralisée optimisée (Cimerman, 2023). Face aux enjeux posés par le changement climatique, deux voies opposées d'adaptation du bâti se dessinent. La première, actuellement dominante, consiste à prolonger cet imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du développement du « smart-building ». Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des réponses clés-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralisés, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de bâtiments. Néanmoins, elle présente certains défis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, coûteuses, complexes, rapidement obsolète

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards. What you will do The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request. 1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report. 2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured. 3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along. 4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFE

Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures. Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si , mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre. Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers. Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk. Pourquoi ce rôle existe Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur. Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage. Vos responsabilités Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients. La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir. Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger. Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision. Votre profil Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47 Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client Vous écrivez clai

jobs.title: VC Analyst - Internship
jobs.description: Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end. At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth. We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 1-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential. We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto . Your role is to help us find, select and invest in those companies. Mission Within Hexa Scale’s team (Thibault, Augustin & Samuel), you’ll participate in the deal-flow cycle to make 2/3 successful deals a year. Outcomes Deal-flow: guarantee volume and reactivity Perform the first analysis of Inbound leads, and therefore guarantee a <48h contact to the entrepreneurs. Identify new companies that fit our investment scope each week for reach out and ensure a strong volume generation at the top of our investment funnel, target: 30 identified companies Help us to enhance our outbound tooling set-up (database, automations, scraping) Research: help perform cutting edge market deep-dives Perform research on sectors that we decide to deep-dive: mapping of actors, mapping of products and features, understanding of competitive landscape, understanding of funding status and exit potential, understanding of value-creation for customers and GTM structures. Participate in qualitative research with market experts: Identify, reach-out and organise calls with market experts that we may not have directly in our network, at scale. Example: generate 10+ interviews with key buyer persona on a researched market. Company analysis: help elaborate clear pictures of our targets Understand and analyse the business model, product, team, growth engine, and overall business plan of our targets. Participate in our version of the BP to understand key assumptions and risks, and generate a clear picture of the investment opportunity. Support Hexa Scale’s team in both intro and due diligence calls Competences & Profile Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree of top Business/Engineering school At least 1 experience in GTM, Tech M&A or an investment role (PE, VC) Entrepreneurship oriented: Great doer, fast self-learner, self-starter mindset Very curious about tech/software and permanently digging topics to get to the heart of things Strong analytical skills and ability to articulate opinions with both numbers and concepts Highly coachable: enjoying and asking for feedback and training Process 1st Intro call with our Talent Team (20min) Meeting with Samuel to get to know each other and discuss about your experiences and interests (20min) Business Case & Feedback session with the team (1h) Reference checks & ☕ with Samuel Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence. In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander) Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update Interface & System Specifications Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines Operational & Field Documentation Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes Coordinate review cycles with Engineeri

jobs.title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. About the Role We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies. Responsibilities: Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement Candidate Profile: Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work) Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus) Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing) Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed Nice to Have Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation) Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware Prior startup or jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte Les cabinets d’avocats indépendants représentent le segment qui connaît la plus forte croissance chez Doctrine, avec une hausse de 50 % sur les 12 derniers mois. Pour accompagner cette dynamique, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la fidélisation de nos clients et le développement de ton portefeuille.  Nous recherchons un·e Account Manager (Retention Specialist) pour rejoindre notre équipe dédiée aux avocats indépendants. Tu seras responsable d’un portefeuille de plus de 800 clients, avec une priorité : leur donner envie de rester chez Doctrine. Cela passe par des échanges réguliers, des démonstrations utiles à leur pratique et des négociations pour renouveler leur abonnement. Tu travailleras avec les Sales Specialists, qui prennent en charge les ventes de produits complémentaires à partir des besoins que tu identifies chez tes clients. Ce poste associe relation client, expertise produit et négociation commerciale, avec un impact direct sur la rétention et la croissance des revenus. Les missions : Contacter les clients qui utilisent peu nos solutions ou rencontrent des difficultés, pour comprendre ce qui bloque et les aider à reprendre leur utilisation. Traiter les demandes de résiliation: comprendre les raisons du départ, répondre aux objections, démontrer la réelles valeur de doctrine  et définir une nouvelle proposition contractuelle pour ré-engager le client. Anticiper les renouvellements d’abonnement et assurer le suivi des engagements pris avec les clients. Réaliser des démonstrations et former les clients à nos solutions. Identifier les opportunités business cross-sell et les transmettre aux Sales Specialists.. Organiser le suivi de ton portefeuille dans le CRM et suivre tes résultats : revenu conservé, renouvellements et clients réactivés. Remonter les retours clients aux équipes Produit et Support, et partager avec l’équipe les approches qui fonctionnent. Tu apprécies les retours pour progresser et tu partages tes conseils avec tes collègues. Tu t’exprimes clairement à l’oral comme à l’écrit, en français. jobs.description: TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (all gender)
jobs.description: Job description Who we are Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here. The Role As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward. Your responsibilities Therapy ownership: You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. Behavior & retention: You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation. YOUR TOOLKIT Mobile expertise: Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. Platform fluency: You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome. Languages: Fluent in German and English. High agency: You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. Taste: You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. Optional – health or behavior background: Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it. OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. Home office is easily possible with us. Body & Mind - You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership and your own leased bicycle at your free disposal. Future - We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you. Impact - work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day. Teamwork - You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work. CONTACT Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? jobs.title: Venture Studio Tech Lead
jobs.description: 👋 Hey, we're Founders Factory Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of 60+ operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, our 400 portfolio companies have raised $1.03bn follow-on funding from leading investors in four continents. 🔍 Who are we looking for? We’re looking for a Tech Lead to build with and support our portfolio of startups with a mix of hands-on execution and strategy within our venture studio. You’ll collaborate with a diverse portfolio of ambitious early-stage founders - this is an opportunity to work across various domains, technologies, and products with a particular focus on helping ventures identify and capture the advantage that modern AI tooling now makes possible, without losing sight of the fundamentals of building resilient, scalable technology. In our venture studio, you will have the unique opportunity to help define, and build new ventures from scratch, in sectors ranging from finance to healthcare, with the support and backing of the largest corporate partners in the world. Our vision is to build a body of knowledge that will become the global blueprint for how to build the leading technology businesses of the future. We are looking for someone who shares that ambition and has the passion and expertise to achieve it. 💪 Your responsibilities As a Venture Studio Tech Lead, you will work across both our Studio and Accelerator as a technical expert, turning new ideas into tangible outcomes and helping founders build AI capability into the core of their products and operations - not as a bolt-on feature. To be successful in this role, you should have previous experience leading teams to build secure, resilient and scalable tech and data science solutions. Building new ventures from scratch We expect that you will be working across several Studio businesses at all times, around 1-2 days/week of support for each. Set the technical direction and provide technical expertise to help shape a big vision for each venture by leading the development and implementation of new ventures and products You will work with cross-functional teams for each studio venture and act as the key technical stakeholder. Strong fundamentals in designing, building, and maintaining resilient distributed and/or high performance systems. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised workloads in cloud environments (GCP and/or AWS). Solid understanding of networking, operating systems, and database technologies. Experience with observability fundamentals metrics, logs, traces, and alerting. Tech stack We are technology agnostic at Encord and not looking for experience across all of these — as long as you're open to learning, please apply. As we approach on-market release, you will also prepare the QMS for customer facing activities including post-market surveillance and complaint handling. You will work as a direct partner to our engineering teams and alongside our dedicated Regulatory Affairs leadership. Audit Leadership: Lead our annual ISO 13485 certification audit, FDA inspection readiness and own the internal, supplier, and customer audit programmes. Cybersecurity: Provide oversight and guidance on cybersecurity aspects impacting product and business processes, including FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (Section 524B) Supplier & Manufacturing Quality: Lead supplier qualification, supplier audits, and manufacturing quality as we build toward commercial production. Work with suppliers to ensure effective Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes are implemented. Establish processes for maintaining Device Master Records, and transfer of batch records to CoMind. Provide oversight and guidance on clinical evaluation / clinical data quality. Skills & Experience: Extensive leadership experience in Quality Assurance within an ISO 13485 environment including product design, manufacturing and commercial customer-facing operations A strong track record of building and managing high-performing Quality teams. Expert command of the core Quality toolkit: QMS, ISO 13485, design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, CAPA, validation, and supplier quality. Experience hosting and leading audits, including annual certification audits. jobs.description: About AirOps AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running. Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search. Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo. About the Role: AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat. You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it. What you'll own: Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline. Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script. Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow. Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win. The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does. Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace. What you'll bring: The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches. Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot. High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution. Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes. A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them. The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. jobs.description: About Us: At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale. As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic. Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction. As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences. Learn more at Sitecore.com . About the Role: This is a rare opportunity to shape how Sitecore grows through its partner ecosystem across two of its most dynamic regions. The Partner Marketing Manager owns joint marketing with Sitecore's implementation partners across EMEA and Asia Pacific, as well as our international reseller community—turning those relationships into a powerful, scalable route to market. You will build and run co-marketing programmes that are deliberately aligned to Sitecore's core FY27 buying motions— including our market-leading CMS SitecoreAI, our AI-powered DAM and Scrunch, the best way to win AI search. Every campaign you launch will be tied to a business problem our customers are actively trying to solve, and to the pipeline and bookings that follow. The role blends ambitious strategic thinking with confident hands-on delivery. You will work shoulder to shoulder with partners, regional sales leaders and the wider marketing organisation to extend Sitecore's reach through and with our ecosystem, and you will see the impact of your work in the pipeline, in partner momentum, and in the customers we win together. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Badoo
jobs.description: Introduction to Role & Team Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business. As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding. You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on. What You’ll Do Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery. Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business. Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results. Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product. Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters. Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version. Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve. Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly. Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards. Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact. Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create. About You You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release. You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens. You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on. You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising. jobs.title: 2D Graphic/Product Designer (Softlines & Kids Accessories) (all genders)
jobs.description: About tonies: tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way. With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination. You as part of tonies: We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval. This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you. This role may NOT be a great fit if: Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design. Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware). You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences. Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork. Your tasks and responsibilities will include: Design ownership across the full PDP Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more. Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand Licensor management Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range Brand stewardship Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue) Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity Cross-functional collaboration Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. What we are looking for: 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)

jobs.description: Vision RT  is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.   Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).   The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the  2025  Sunday Times 100 Tech   list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.   Company video   With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.   Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.   About the role We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Management Accountant to join our finance team. This role plays a critical part in delivering accurate financial insights, supporting strategic decision-making, and driving business performance. As a Senior Management Accountant, you will be responsible for preparing monthly management accounts, performing financial analysis, and partnering with key stakeholders across the business. You will ensure the integrity of financial reporting while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and profitability. Working closely with senior leadership, you will provide meaningful commentary on financial performance, budgets, and forecasts, helping to guide business strategy. This role also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to the continuous development of the finance function.  This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant looking to take on a high-impact role within a dynamic and fast-paced environment. jobs.title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
jobs.description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations. Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria. Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms. Starting date : 01/01/2027 Profile and application: PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab). References: [1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib. , doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633. [2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib. , 453, 328-354. LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon) Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight) Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
